question: Which group of rivers is a part of the peninsular drainage system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahanadi and Godavari.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mahanadi and Godavari** are two of the major rivers that are** part of the Peninsular drainage system** in India.
 
• The Peninsular River System, unlike the Himalayan River System, is mainly **composed of older rivers that have a fixed course** and do not substantially change direction or characteristics with seasons.
